recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-13751 unless humans choose to separately tidy non-rendered comments or retired ProcessRequest material.
issue_request: FHIR-13751 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Financial Management change request asking whether ExplanationOfBenefit.type's Claim Type terminology should stop saying "Example" and stop using the example-looking ex-claimtype URI after the binding had changed from required to extensible.
initial_application: Commit 49ee52b963abadc71e75fff3c1f5e31e86d25d30 changed source/claim/valueset-claim-type.xml from "Example Claim Type Codes", sample/example text, and http://hl7.org/fhir/ex-claimtype to "Claim Type Codes", HL7 copyright, and http://hl7.org/fhir/claim-type. Commit cff1ea3a296fa00d51eaed13763ffd518bbc7378 changed ExplanationOfBenefit examples from ex-claimtype to claim-type while applying Tracker #13751. Later commit b63ba456ef969b5e173fc94623f34884301e68cc moved the CodeSystem reference to terminology.hl7.org.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit in the active resource list. The current Claim Type ValueSet title and description no longer use Example/sample wording, and it composes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/claim-type. Current Claim.type, ClaimResponse.type, and ExplanationOfBenefit.type each bind extensibly to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/claim-type. Remaining ex-claimtype hits are an XML comment in a Communication example and retired ProcessRequest text; ProcessRequest is commented out of fhir.ini. FHIR-13614 is the predecessor mismatch report and was treated as background rather than a separately decided issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already matches the accepted FHIR-13751 decision and no build-scope source correction is needed.
